cd-island-lake-getchel-pavilion-1922.st: On 4 July 1920 a picnic celebration with a ball game was held in "Getchel's grove, Island Lake" (Ladysmith News-Budget, 2 Jul 1920, p. 1). The grove and the pavilion were the same Getchel ground. The 1915 Rusk plat draws houses without owner names, so it can't place the grove.
src: Ladysmith News-Budget, 2 Jul 1920, p. 1 (newspapers.com, PC thread sweep)
